contract.traceability: Reference `ref` (TestRail case id, e.g. C4099911) in each automated test so a result maps back to its case.
contract.markers: Mirror device + feature as pytest markers; add @pytest.mark.destructive where destructive is true (deselected by default).
contract.cross_check: cross_check lists the back-office systems the case asserts — the test must verify the event landed there (CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack).
contract.note: automatable/priority are system-test-ops judgements and a starting point; the automation engineer may override with rationale.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator clears a valid card
steps.then:
**THEN** the card is cleared
**AND** success is reported

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator attempts to clear an invalid card
steps.then: **THEN** the operation is reported as unsuccessful with a card error

gherkin.expected: A valid card clears successfully and an invalid card reports a Card Error.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator dumps a valid card
steps.then:
**THEN** the card data is read
**AND** success is reported

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator attempts to dump an invalid card
steps.then: **THEN** the operation is reported as unsuccessful

gherkin.expected: A valid card dump succeeds and an invalid card reports unsuccessful.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator performs a Data Download
steps.then:
**THEN** the data is downloaded
**AND** a 'Data Download Successful' confirmation is shown

gherkin.expected: Data Download completes and shows the success confirmation.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator changes the Home Location, Boarding Location, Mounting Point and Tray Identifier
steps.then:
**THEN** each setting is updated
**AND** each setting is retained
**AND** the default Boarding Stage and Mounting Point are correct

gherkin.expected: Device settings change and persist, with correct default Boarding Stage and Mounting Point (regression: TIBU-22632).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator opens Network Settings and changes a setting
steps.then:
**THEN** the screen responds to the input
**AND** the change is applied

gherkin.expected: Administrator Network Settings respond to input and apply changes (regression: TIBU-24740).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator initiates, refreshes and exits Force Comms
steps.then:
**THEN** each action completes
**AND** the administrator returns to the Administrator menu

gherkin.expected: Force Comms can be initiated, refreshed and exited from the Administrator menu.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an administrator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the administrator views and prints the serial, software and configuration versions
steps.then:
**THEN** each version set is displayed
**AND** each version set is printed

gherkin.expected: Serial, software and configuration versions are viewable and printable from the Administrator menu.

cases.title: Barcode — validate a ticket by barcode

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator accesses Barcode Reference via the Operator Menu

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator scans a ticket barcode
steps.then:
**THEN** the ticket validation screen shows the information for that barcode type
**AND** any Notes on that barcode type are shown
**AND** pressing any key (or a 3s timeout) returns to the FLU screen

gherkin.expected: Scanning a ticket barcode shows the type-appropriate validation info (incl. Notes) for the operator's visual check, then returns to FLU.

cases.title: Barcode — offline validations stored until reconnect

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the POS is offline (no CloudFare/Corethree connection)

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator validates barcodes
steps.then: **THEN** the offline validations are stored in a list

steps.when: **WHEN** connection to CloudFare/Corethree is re-established
steps.then: **THEN** the stored validations are synced

gherkin.expected: Offline barcode validations are queued and synced on reconnect to CloudFare/Corethree.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator has issued a ticket this shift

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator has just issued a new smartcard

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the printer is in a paper-jam state after a transaction

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator presses Annul Transaction on the Paper Jam screen
steps.then:
**THEN** the annul control responds
**AND** the transaction is annulled

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator has just issued an Adult Belfast Visitors Pass

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator annuls the issue
steps.then: **THEN** the Belfast Visitors Pass issue is annulled successfully

gherkin.expected: A new Adult Belfast Visitors Pass can be annulled (regression: TIBU-21443).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator is annulling the last transaction

steps.when: **WHEN** a different card is presented during the annul flow
steps.then:
**THEN** the mismatch is handled gracefully
**AND** the device is not left stuck

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator has just issued a ticket this shift

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator annuls that ticket issue
steps.then:
**THEN** the ticket issue is annulled
**AND** the annulment is recorded
**AND** an annulment receipt is printed

gherkin.expected: A newly issued ticket annuls with the correct outcome and a printed annulment receipt.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on and has built one or more fares

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator adds them to the basket and opens the basket
steps.then:
**THEN** the basket lists the items with the correct total
**AND** the expected basket buttons are present

gherkin.expected: Items are added and the basket shows the items, correct total and controls (regression: TIBU-21777, TIBU-24364).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the basket contains one or more items

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator presses Clear Basket
steps.then: **THEN** the basket is emptied

gherkin.expected: Clear Basket removes all items (regression: TIBU-24368).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the basket contains multiple items

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator proceeds to checkout
steps.then:
**THEN** the checkout total equals the sum of the items
**AND** 'add more to basket' is unavailable when the basket cannot accept more

gherkin.expected: Checkout total is correct and 'add more' is disabled when appropriate (regression: TIBU-24098, TIBU-24860).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator is adding tickets to the basket

steps.when: **WHEN** the basket reaches 9 tickets
steps.then: **THEN** the Add More button becomes unavailable

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator deletes a ticket from the basket
steps.then: **THEN** the Add More button becomes available again

cases.title: Basket — entitlement passes cannot be basketed

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator has built a fare using a smartcard entitlement pass

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator attempts to add it to the basket
steps.then:
**THEN** the fare cannot be basketed
**AND** it must be validated and paid as an individual transaction

gherkin.expected: Entitlement-pass fares cannot be added to a basket; they require per-transaction validation.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is building a bus basket on a route

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator tries to add a ticket from a different route
steps.then: **THEN** it is not allowed

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator adds tickets with two different boarding stages on the same route
steps.then: **THEN** both are accepted

gherkin.expected: A bus basket is limited to one route; multiple boarding stages on that route are allowed.

gherkin.given:
**GIVEN** a payment card device (PCD) is attached and the POS is in NIR or Ulsterbus mode
**AND** the basket/fare is ready for payment

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator selects Bank Card and the customer pays by contactless, chip & PIN, or swipe
steps.then:
**THEN** the payment terminal authorises the transaction
**AND** the ticket is printed as soon as the transaction succeeds
**AND** the customer is offered an optional payment receipt
**AND** the POS returns to the Bus/Rail FLU screen

gherkin.expected: Bank Card payment authorises and prints the ticket (receipt optional), via contactless/chip&PIN/swipe. NIR + Ulsterbus only; the Bank Card option is hidden if no PCD is attached (regression: TIBU-24777, TIBU-24834).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator is on the payment screen for a single ticket

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator presses Back
steps.then: **THEN** the operator is returned to the basket/fare with its state intact

gherkin.expected: Back from the payment screen returns cleanly with state intact (regression: TIBU-24876).

cases.title: Card Payment — declined, cancelled or error

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the customer is paying by bank card

steps.when: **WHEN** the card is declined
steps.then:
**THEN** a declined message is shown
**AND** a declined receipt is printed

steps.when: **WHEN** the customer cancels on the PIN pad before entering the PIN
steps.then: **THEN** the transaction is cancelled with no cancelled-payment receipt

steps.when: **WHEN** the PIN is entered incorrectly too many times, or the amount is too big for a card, or the signature does not match
steps.then:
**THEN** the matching error message (driven by the M020/PCD) is shown
**AND** the POS returns to the payment screen

gherkin.expected: Each card error path shows the correct message: declined (with receipt), cancelled-before-PIN (no receipt), too many PIN attempts, value too big, signature mismatch — then returns to payment.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the basket has one or more items

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator takes cash payment and completes the transaction
steps.then:
**THEN** the transaction completes
**AND** the basket is issued

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator builds and cash-pays a further basket on a different route
steps.then: **THEN** that transaction also completes without the device freezing

gherkin.expected: Cash payment completes for a basket and subsequent baskets/routes without freezing (regression: TIBU-19336, TIBU-7379).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator has taken cash sales and at least one annulment during the shift

steps.when: **WHEN** the End of Shift cash total is produced
steps.then: **THEN** the total is the net amount, accounting for annulments

gherkin.expected: The EOS cash total is net of annulments and the annulment total is correct (regression: TIBU-29484, TIBU-30634).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator completes an issuing transaction (ticket, card issue or top-up)

steps.when: **WHEN** the transaction completes
steps.then: **THEN** a receipt is printed

gherkin.expected: Every issuing transaction prints its receipt (regression: TIBU-21135, TIBU-21176, TIBU-23016, TIBU-21266).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator completes a transaction that prints a receipt

steps.when: **WHEN** the receipt prints
steps.then: **THEN** exactly one receipt is produced

gherkin.expected: Transactions print a single receipt, never duplicates (regression: TIBU-22548, TIBU-22557).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator prints a ticket/receipt

steps.when: **WHEN** the printout is produced
steps.then:
**THEN** it uses the correct template, fonts and current Translink logo
**AND** rail ticket templates follow the revised naming
**AND** a missing template is handled gracefully with no crash

gherkin.expected: Printouts use the right template/fonts/logo/naming, and a missing template is handled gracefully (regression: TIBU-23835, TIBU-24890, TIBU-23096, TIBU-16109, TIBU-24848).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator prints a mini statement for a smartcard

steps.when: **WHEN** the mini statement prints
steps.then:
**THEN** it shows the correct information including the actual expiry date
**AND** the printout is long enough to contain all content
**AND** an expired multi-journey card still prints its receipt

gherkin.expected: Mini statements print correct content with a real expiry, adequate length, incl. expired MJ cards (regression: TIBU-20759, TIBU-21581, TIBU-23989, TIBU-21178, TIBU-21463).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** card transactions have occurred during the day

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator prints the day summary
steps.then: **THEN** the printout includes the card transaction details

gherkin.expected: The day summary print includes card transaction details (regression: TIBU-24800).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is building and paying for a fare

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator adds items and takes payment
steps.then:
**THEN** the passenger display shows the fare and running total
**AND** the passenger display updates as the transaction progresses

gherkin.expected: The passenger display works, showing the fare/total and updating through the transaction (regression: TIBU-24845).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on in Rail (NIR) mode and building a fare

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator adds items and takes payment
steps.then:
**THEN** the passenger display shows the rail fare and running total
**AND** the passenger display updates as the transaction progresses

gherkin.expected: In Rail mode the passenger display shows the fare/total and updates through the transaction.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on in Ulsterbus mode and building a fare

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator adds items and takes payment
steps.then:
**THEN** the passenger display shows the Ulsterbus fare and running total
**AND** the passenger display updates as the transaction progresses

gherkin.expected: In Ulsterbus mode the passenger display shows the fare/total and updates through the transaction.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator is building a fare

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator selects a passenger type
steps.then:
**THEN** the passenger type is applied
**AND** the price updates

gherkin.expected: Selecting a passenger type applies it and updates the price. Each passenger type is a data variation.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator is building a fare

steps.when: **WHEN** the basket total exceeds the configured cash limit
steps.then: **THEN** the Cash Limit error is shown

gherkin.expected: Exceeding the configured cash limit shows the Cash Limit error and blocks the over-limit cash transaction.

gherkin.given: **Given** an operator is signed on and a blank smartcard is presented

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator selects the product, takes payment and issues it to the card
steps.then:
**THEN** the product is written to the card at the correct price
**AND** a receipt is printed

gherkin.expected: A product issues onto a blank card with a receipt. Run across products — Metro Multi-Journey, Multi-Journey, DayLink, iLink, Metro Travelcard, Belfast Visitor Pass, Ulsterbus Multi-Journey, Town Service Travelcard.

cases.title: Issue Card — recognised by other devices

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator has created a new card from blank on the POS

steps.when: **WHEN** the card is presented to another device (ETM/TVM) and back to the POS for top-up
steps.then:
**THEN** the card is recognised as valid
**AND** it can be topped up

gherkin.expected: Cards created on the POS are recognised by other devices and can be topped up (regression: TIBU-21446, TIBU-22603, TIBU-23996, TIBU-26721, TIBU-26722).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator places an Adult BVP or iLink Zone 1 'blank' card on the POS

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator selects the Adult Belfast Visitors option
steps.then:
**THEN** the correct Belfast Visitors options are offered
**AND** the iLink Zone card options are not shown

gherkin.expected: Selecting Adult Belfast Visitors on a blank BVP/iLink Zone 1 card shows the correct options, not the iLink Zone options (regression: TIBU-23963).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator has selected a group-eligible product with boarding/alighting set

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator enters a passenger count (or uses + / -) up to 100 and confirms
steps.then:
**THEN** a single group ticket is printed
**AND** one back-office transaction is recorded with a sub-element per passenger

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator selects a non-group-eligible product or an invalid count
steps.then: **THEN** an error banner is shown

gherkin.expected: A group ticket issues for up to 100 passengers as one printed ticket and one multi-passenger transaction; non-eligible products/counts are rejected. Group eligibility is configured in Cloudfare.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the operator is taking a cash payment

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator enters the amount tendered and selects Calculate Change
steps.then:
**THEN** the change is calculated
**AND** the change is shown

steps.when: **WHEN** too many digits are entered, or the amount is less than the ticket value, or the previous transaction had no value
steps.then: **THEN** the Calculate Change option is unavailable

gherkin.expected: Change is calculated for a valid tendered amount; the option is hidden for too-many-digits / under-value / no-value cases.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator opens Operator Options
steps.then:
**THEN** the expected operator options are listed
**AND** no 'Report Faulty Payment Device' option is shown

gherkin.expected: Operator Options shows the correct set of options, with no spurious 'Report Faulty Payment Device' entry (regression: TIBU-22640).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator selects Totals
steps.then: **THEN** the operator's totals are displayed

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator prints the totals
steps.then: **THEN** the totals print without a fatal error

gherkin.expected: The operator's totals are displayed and printed with no fatal error (regression: TIBU-20914).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** a valid operator

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator signs on, then signs off, and separately a forced sign-off occurs
steps.then:
**THEN** a Sign On event is recorded to CloudFare
**AND** a Sign Off event is recorded to CloudFare
**AND** a Forced Sign Off event is recorded to CloudFare

gherkin.expected: Each of sign-on, sign-off and forced sign-off produces its corresponding CloudFare audit event for the operator.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the POS has lost communication with CloudFare for longer than the configured period

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator attempts to sign on
steps.then:
**THEN** the "Communication Locked" screen is shown
**AND** it states the device was automatically locked due to lost communication
**AND** it instructs the operator to "Notify a Supervisor or Technician"

gherkin.expected: Once comms are lost beyond the configured period the device enters Communication Locked and sign-on is blocked (regression: TIBU-28530, TIBU-21278).

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the POS is showing the Sign On screen

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator enters an unrecognised ID or PIN and presses Enter
steps.then:
**THEN** the "Sign On Failed" screen is shown with "The ID or PIN is incorrect"
**AND** the attempt counter is shown (e.g. "1 of 3")
**AND** the operator is returned to the Sign On screen to retry

gherkin.expected: Sign-on is rejected with the 'Sign On Failed' message and an attempt counter, the operator can retry, and the ID must be entered before the PIN (regression: TIBU-22671, TIBU-24379).

cases.title: Sign On — device locks after the configured failed attempts

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** the configured failed-attempt lockout threshold (set via TMS)

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator enters incorrect credentials up to the configured number of times
steps.then:
**THEN** the device locks after the configured number of attempts
**AND** a Device Locked screen is shown

gherkin.expected: After the TMS-configured number of failed sign-on attempts the device locks and shows the Device Locked screen (regression: TIBU-22672, TIBU-22003).

cases.title: Sign On — unlock with Supervisor card

gherkin.given:
**GIVEN** the POS is displaying the Device Locked screen
**AND** the POS is communicating with CloudFare

steps.when: **WHEN** a supervisor presents a valid Supervisor card
steps.then:
**THEN** the device is unlocked
**AND** the POS returns to the Sign On screen

gherkin.expected: Presenting a valid Supervisor card unlocks the device and returns it to the Sign On screen (regression: TIBU-21384).

cases.title: Sign On — screen, field entry and the 'C' key

gherkin.given: **Given** the ETM is idle

steps.when: **WHEN** the Sign On screen is displayed
steps.then: **THEN** the ID and PIN fields are shown

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator enters digits into a field
steps.then:
**THEN** the field updates
**AND** the 'C' key clears one character at a time

steps.when: **WHEN** no entry is made
steps.then: **THEN** the ETM remains on or returns to the idle Sign On screen

gherkin.expected: The Sign On screen shows ID and PIN fields; field entry updates and 'C' clears a character; idle returns to the Sign On screen.

gherkin.given: **Given** an operator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator signs off
steps.then:
**THEN** the ETM returns to the idle screen
**AND** the sign-off is audited

gherkin.expected: Sign off returns the ETM to idle and audits the event. Run for each role — Operator, Supervisor, Technician, Administrator.

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the configured inactivity period elapses with no interaction
steps.then:
**THEN** the operator is automatically signed off
**AND** the POS returns to the Idle screen

gherkin.expected: After the configured inactivity period the operator is automatically signed off and the POS returns to Idle.

cases.title: Sign Off — forced by power cycle

gherkin.given: **GIVEN** an operator is signed on

steps.when: **WHEN** the POS is power-cycled during the shift
steps.then:
**THEN** on restart the POS returns to the Idle screen

gherkin.expected: After a power cycle the POS restarts to Idle and records a single Forced Sign-off event (regression: TIBU-24790).

cases.title: Sign On — by role (manual and smartcard)

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator enters a valid ID and PIN and confirms

steps.when: **WHEN** the operator presents a valid staff smartcard instead
steps.then: **THEN** the ID is pre-populated and, after a valid PIN, the operator reaches their role menu

steps.when: **WHEN** the supervisor opens Versions and views the serial, software and configuration versions
